national_news.title: Digital Self-Enumeration for Census 2027 Commences in Ladakh
bullets: Ladakh becomes the first Union Territory to complete Census 2027, with self‑enumeration from Aug 17‑31 and population enumeration from Sep 1‑30, scheduled to finish by Oct 1

bihar_news.title: Ministry of Mines to Organise Roadshow on 8th Tranche of Critical and Strategic Minerals in Bihar
bullets: Ministry of Mines will conduct a roadshow in Bihar to showcase the 8th tranche of critical and strategic minerals.
The programme will feature a presentation on the National Mineral Exploration and Development Trust (NMEDT) Scheme.
Dr. Pramod Kumar, Mines Minister of Bihar, will attend and highlight the state's role in mineral development.
